title: Source
description: Provenance of an entry: which document, pages and section it came from, under which license, and which lot produced it. Homebrew entries carry origin 'homebrew' and an owner.

document.description: Source document id, e.g. 'srd-5.2.1'. For homebrew, the owner's collection id.

pages.description: PDF pages the entry's text comes from (PDF page = printed page in the SRD 5.2.1).

section.description: Outline path of the source section, as in inventory outline.json (e.g. 'Spells/Spell Descriptions/Fireball').

owner.description: Homebrew only: id of the user or table that owns the entry.

extracted_by.description: Lot that produced the entry (official content).
